map.铸件（拔模斜度）设计 使用指南: Casting Draft Angle Design User Guide
map.铸件拔模斜度设计工具按输入参数计算铸造拔模角与尺寸补偿，避免脱模困难与尺寸偏差，: The casting draft-angle design tool computes the casting draft angle and dimensional compensation from input parameters, avoiding demolding difficulty and dimensional deviation—ideal for casting process design and mold ejection plans.
map.拔模斜度 α=arctan(Δh/H)（壁厚差/高度）。: Draft angle α = arctan(Δh/H) (wall-thickness difference / height).
map.按材料与铸造方法取推荐斜度（木模/金属模）。: Take the recommended draft by material and casting method (wood pattern / metal pattern).
map.校核拔模后尺寸是否超差。: Check whether post-draft dimensions exceed tolerance.
map.：铸件高 H=100 mm、单边壁厚差 Δh=1 mm：α=arctan(1/1: : Casting height H=100 mm, single-side wall-thickness difference Δh=1 mm: α = arctan(1/100) = 0.573° ≈ 0.5°. Metal patterns usually take 0.5°–1°, wood patterns 1°–3°.
map.：斜度使大端尺寸增大 Δh，标注需注明参考端（小端/大端），避免加工余量不足。: : The draft enlarges the large-end dimension by Δh; the drawing must note the reference end (small/large) to avoid insufficient machining allowance.
map.为什么要有拔模斜度？: Why is a draft angle needed?
map.使铸件顺利脱模、不拉伤型腔，尤其深腔/复杂件必需；斜度过小脱模困难、过大增料。: It lets the casting release smoothly without scoring the cavity—essential for deep-cavity/complex parts; too small makes demolding hard, too large adds material.
map.斜度取大端还是小端？: Draft referenced to large end or small end?
map.通常标注小端为基本尺寸、大端自然增大；或反向（加工面取小端保证余量），需图纸明确: Usually the small end is the basic dimension and the large end grows naturally; or reversed (machined faces take the small end to ensure allowance)—the drawing must specify.
